senses.gloss:
ITA-5.72.29 makṣikā-daṣṭaḥ मक्षिका-दष्टः
Reaction due to sting of honeybee
Poisoning characterized by itching; oedema; burning sensation; pain; brownish-coloured papules; fever; death.

ITA-8.2.33 mākṣikam माक्षिकम्
Oil-like honey
A variety of honey which resembles oil in colour and produced by tawny honeybees.
